div.div:
Canaries prove the limits are real
node memory.max and cpu.max equal the preset, swap 0, allocatable = limit minus overhead. Oversized pod stays Pending. Memory hog: node stays Ready, pod exits 137. Taint repels pods without a toleration. Second just up changes nothing

div.div: Docker caps each node container and the kubelet reservation makes allocatable match, so the scheduler cannot overcommit a node. CPU is a CFS quota, not core isolation. An OOM kill shows as exit code 137 and not reason OOMKilled, so detect it by exit code plus node events. Profiles: minimal is infra, dev is infra, control and workers, full adds obs, ci is dev driven by tilt ci. Presets change only the numbers.
